scope: Implement the restart-safe executable H0.0 control scaffold and prove Status, Plan and Resume from Git-only state without creating or changing runtime code.
required_outputs: Draft pull request and checkpoint proposal
stop_conditions: Any gameplay or runtime path would need to change
Canonical harness contracts appear contradictory or require modification
Risk must be raised to HIGH or CRITICAL
A blocking Human Attention decision is required before implementation can continue
risk_reasons: The scaffold is control infrastructure whose incorrect state reconstruction could route later development to the wrong checkpoint.
The new Status, Plan and Resume interface defines public control behavior and recovery semantics, which are explicit HIGH minimum-risk triggers.
The implementation is bounded and does not mutate gameplay/runtime or canonical architecture ownership.

design_brief.problem_statement: Canonical harness, risk, review and evidence contracts exist in main, but no executable Status, Plan or Resume implementation exists.
design_brief.current_behavior: A new session must manually interpret control files and cannot reconstruct an active execution train through one canonical command.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A thin PowerShell entrypoint and modular Python implementation load canonical contracts, treat append-only events as the authoritative execution state, validate any mutable Work Order state only as a derived snapshot, validate epochs, build status, plan the declared checkpoint and resume from Git-only state.
alternatives_considered: Implement all behavior in one PowerShell script.
Implement a thin PowerShell entrypoint over focused Python modules.
Build a full autonomous execution engine in H0.0.
design_brief.selected_design: Use a thin PowerShell entrypoint over focused Python modules with JSON output derived from canonical contracts and branch-local execution instances.
design_brief.why_selected: The modular design is testable and cross-session recoverable while keeping H0.0 bounded to read/plan/resume behavior and excluding autonomous runtime execution.
dependencies: Git refs and immutable worker events
non_goals: No C22 or NX runtime branch creation
No canonical schema or policy revision
No architecture promotion or ownership transfer
expected_risks: Incorrect event ordering or transition reduction
Dual truth between append-only events and the mutable Work Order state snapshot
Confusing an event subject head with the actual Git ledger/ref head that contains the event
False epoch freshness after main moves
Derived state depending on artifacts or chat
Incomplete review or Human Attention state in Resume
Planner bypassing the H0.0 pilot override
validation_plan: Validate all canonical control, review and evidence contracts load.
Exercise valid and invalid Work Order, Event, Epoch, Evidence Map and Human Attention instances.
Reduce ordered fixtures including FIX_REQUIRED and recovery continuation.
Reject or report disagreement between event-derived state and the Work Order state snapshot.
Report event subject head and actual ledger/ref head as distinct fields.
Validate semantic cross-contract invariants that JSON Schema alone cannot express.
Detect exact-main, moved-main CONTINUE and REFRESH_REQUIRED epoch states.
Prove Status, Plan and Resume output from a clean checkout after artifacts are removed.
Prove dry-run C22 remains blocked until H0_0_SCAFFOLD_READY.
Run git diff --check and Project Control non-RED.

notes: H0.0 may prepare HUMAN_OBSERVATION work-order shapes and R3 analysis state, but it must not create autonomous runtime branches.
